payload.title: Phase 2 of Task-Lock System — Cowork-Team Slot Locking
payload.model_selected: Model 1 — master holds lock 900s TTL, agents do NOT heartbeat. Consistent with brief §7 (cowork-slot TTL=900, master-only). Rationale: TTL covers one 15-min scheduler cycle; if agent stalls, next tick gets fresh nominal_tick + fresh lock key. Simpler than Model 2.

1955a_kickoff_constraints.scope_only: Master holds the lock. Do NOT touch any agent cycle.md files. Do NOT touch other flows.
1955a_kickoff_constraints.task_id_format: cowork-slot:<slot.agent>:<nominal_tick> where nominal_tick is floor-15-min ISO UTC already in cowork-match-slots.js drift_min math

edge_cases.spawn_failure_after_claim: task_release immediately (release in finally/after-spawn block whether success or failure)
edge_cases.claimed_false_logging: [cowork-team] slot held by ${result.current_holder.owner_session} → WORK channel, skip spawn

ac: Step 4.6 inserted between current Step 4b and Step 5
claim+release calls follow skill grammar (call_tool form)
decision comment block explains Model 1 (master-holds, no agent heartbeat)
all_held case → silent exit + telemetry all_held=true
spawn error after claim → release immediately
commit on main with conventional-commit message
drop signal docs/signals/agent-father-1955a-done.json for qa to start 1955b
